frames.gloss: A 是 B 的家园/栖息地（某类生物或事物大量所在之处）。
frames.pattern_notes:
home 前零冠词、其后直接接 to 短语，功能上相当于 'be the home of'，A 为地点/环境，B 为栖息其中的生物或事物。
误读点：学习者按字面回推成 the home of 或加冠词 a home to；此处 home 是不可数的介词性用法，整存整取有查表优势。

examples.s: For one thing, there are the wide plains in the interior of the country, which are home to millions of grazing animals.
This green, watery world is home to many birds and fishes.
The sea is home to life, not human beings’ possessions.

frames.gloss: 按规矩/按预期应当或被指望做某事（半情态被动式）。
frames.pattern_notes:
被动形态表义：be supposed to 表'按规定理应'，be expected to 表'被预期/被指望'，主语是逻辑上的动作承受者。
误读点：学习者易把 expected/supposed 还原成被动动作'被期待着去做'而读慢；整存整取有查表优势。同族还有 be allowed/permitted to（本批 S02534、S01228），但语义更接近普通情态被动，未计入例证。

examples.s: Katie: That's how people in Japan are expected to greet each other.
Later I found out French people are supposed to kiss when they see each other.
The experiment is now in its and is expected to be completed next week.

frames.gloss: 足够 A，能做某事（A 为形容词，enough 后置）。
frames.pattern_notes:
enough 固定后置于形容词/副词（修饰名词时则前置），后接 to 不定式表结果能力；可加否定或疑问（never brave enough to / Who is brave enough to）。
与已收录的 too...to 方向相反：enough 表'足以能做'，too 表'太…而不能做'。误读点：中国学习者常错置为 enough brave；never 的否定辖域也易读错。

examples.s: Wang Ming: Yu Gong said they could put it into the sea because it's big enough to hold everything.
She was never brave enough to ask questions.
Who is brave enough to eat my house?

frames.frame: One of the [评价性复数NP] is that/to [B]
frames.gloss: （诸多原因/目标/特点中）一个主要的…是 B：用于归因、点明目的或给出评价。
frames.pattern_notes:
主语槽为 'One of the + 最高级或评价性形容词 + 复数名词'（或 'One 评价名词 about X'），谓语 is 后接 that 从句或 to 不定式/V-ing 作表语。
误读点：one of the 要求复数名词（易漏复数），且表语 that 从句不修饰前面的名词；变体 'One great thing about [X] is that...' 同功能。

examples.s: One of the main reasons is that people want to challenge themselves in the face of difficulties.
One of the main goals of terraforming Mars is to warm it up because the average temperature there is about -60°C.
One of the most dangerous parts of space exploration is helping people to escape Earth’s g.
One great thing about Singapore is that the temperature is almost the same all year round.

frames.gloss: 是 A 而不是 B：陈述后追补否定，做对比修正。
frames.pattern_notes:
肯定陈述 A 之后用逗号加 not（或 but not）引出被排除的平行对比项 B，A、B 结构对仗。
误读点：not 否定的是 B 这个对比焦点而非主句谓语，学习者易当全句否定而读反；常与 only 连用（only A, not B）。疑问句中 'in A, but not in B' 为同构。

examples.s: The sea is home to life, not human beings’ possessions.
Books will only be on computers, not on paper.
What is in the email, but not in the postcard?

candidates.note: wh-分割句（what-分割句）：'What this means is that...' 主语从句+is that 表语，误读判据强，本批仅 1 例，未达 2 例门槛。

example.s: What this means is that people who chew too quickly end up eating too much food because they still feel hungry.

candidates.note: 已有框架 'This/That is (exactly) why/what' 的新变体：'that is when [从句]'，仅 1 例。

example.s: William Blake Read poetry aloud Poetry should always be read aloud, as that is when you can hear the music of the words.

candidates.note: 已有框架 as long as 的新变体：'for as long as [从句]' 表时长（'在…期间一直'而非条件'只要'），仅 1 例。

example.s: They are the only teachers here, and they plan to stay for as long as there are children who need to attend school.

candidates.note: 已有框架 not only...but also 的倒装变体：句首 Not only 触发主谓倒装（Not only is our food...），误读判据极强，仅 1 例。

example.s: Not only is our food often lacking in flavour and nutrition, but we have lost touch with some of our cultural heritage and the rhythms of nature, and the joy of anticipation has been lost.

candidates.note: 让步义 while（≈although）：误读判据强（易读作'当…时'），本批仅 1 例。

example.s: While the film has many funny moments, it also has times of great sadness.

candidates.note: 评价性 -ing 副词作句子插入语：'Most worrying, though, ...'（另见 S03559 'More importantly'），插入语盲区，各仅 1 例。

example.s: Most worrying, though, I got the flu easily and experienced many toothaches, too.

candidates.note: 'if anything' 插入语（即便有也/要说有什么变化的话）：误读判据强，仅 1 例。

example.s: What, if anything, do these cuisines tell you about the people who eat them?

candidates.note: 承前省略：不定式省略保留 to be（'there was no reason to be [nervous]'），正则盲区'承前省略并列'，仅 1 例。

example.s: I was a bit nervous before I arrived here, but there was no reason to be.

candidates.note: everywhere 引导的地点从句（'Everywhere I go, ...'）：从句功能误读风险，仅 1 例。

example.s: Everywhere I go, I see restaurants and snack stalls—it seems to be a big part of their culture.

candidates.note: 最高级 + ever + V-ed 后置强化（'the largest structure ever made'）：ever 辖域易读错，仅 1 例。

example.s: The Great Wall The Great Wall of China is the largest structure ever made and one of the great wonders of the world.

candidates.note: long 作中位副词表'长久以来一直'（'have long been favourites'）：易误读为形容词'长的'，仅 1 例。

example.s: The nature poems by William Wordsworth, Ode to the West Wind by Percy Bysshe Shelley, George Gordon Byron’s Isles of Greece, and long poems by John Keats have long been favourites.

candidates.note: 已有框架 'It takes sb time to' 的变体：'it will take [时间] before [从句]'（多久之后才…），仅 1 例。

example.s: Nevertheless, it will take some years before most new homes begin to use this new technology.

candidates.note: 隐喻框架 '[A] is only half the game/story/battle'（A 只是事情的一半）：惯用隐喻，字面读必错，仅 1 例。

example.s: Besides, winning or losing is only half the game.

candidates.note: 'it helps if/to...'（如果…会有帮助）：虚指 it 前指条件，骨架判据够但仅 1 例（此句原文有缺损）。

example.s: B: Well, it helps if you remember that there are four countries that the UK.

candidates.note: used to 家族歧义，建议并入既有 used to 词条作变体说明：S03282 'get used to + NP'（习惯于）；另 S02585 'Are these senses used to describe Sarek in the text?' 为'被用来'义，两者各仅 1 例且方向相反，是经典混淆点。

example.s: I’m a bit worried about keeping up with the other students in my advanced course, and it’ll be quite difficult to get used to all the homework.

candidates.note: those + 形容词后置（'those responsible for'）与行为名词名词化串联（'the arrest of those responsible'），同句两个正则盲区，仅 1 例。

example.s: $5 million reward has been announced for information leading to the arrest of those responsible for the.

candidates.note: 'the way + S + V' 零关系代词方式从句（'the way I hit the shark'）：误读风险中等，仅 1 例。

example.s: I wonder how the great DiMaggio would have liked the way I hit the shark in the brain?

candidates.note: such as 本批重复 3 次（S02635/S00574/S03524）但更像词汇连接语，槽位间无固定骨架，判据 1 不足，未按框架报，供聚合时复核。

example.s: I have also read about some iconic sites, such as the Sydney Opera House and the Great Ocean Road, and animals like the cute koalas and kangaroos.

candidates.note: 'What do you know about...' 本批重复 3 次（S08395/S03985/S04393）但均为教材导入题指令，语域判据不符（题目模板同构重复），未按框架报。

example.s: Using Language What do you know about New Zealand?

candidates.note: be made of/from/by/in 本批 4 例（J01279/S05324/S01493/J02926），属被动语态+材料介词搭配（纯语法/词汇范畴），判据 1 不足，未按框架报。

example.s: Brazil has produced and used biofuel made from sugar cane for 40 years.
